description: Na₇Zr₆F₃₁ crystallizes in the trigonal R3 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.56 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.57 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six F atoms. There are three shorter (2.48 Å) and three longer (2.52 Å) Na-F bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Zr sites. In the first Zr site, Zr is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight F atoms. There are a spread of Zr-F bond distances ranging from 2.06-2.19 Å. In the second Zr site, Zr is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine F atoms. There are a spread of Zr-F bond distances ranging from 2.09-2.55 Å. There are eleven inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to two Zr atoms. In the second F site, F is bonded to three Na and one Zr atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing FNa₃Zr tetrahedra. In the third F site, F is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to two Zr atoms. In the fourth F site, F is bonded to two equivalent Na and two Zr atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing FNa₂Zr₂ tetrahedra. In the fifth F site, F is bonded to three Na and one Zr atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing FNa₃Zr tetrahedra. In the sixth F site, F is bonded to two equivalent Na and two Zr atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing FNa₂Zr₂ tetrahedra. In the seventh F site, F is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent Zr atoms. In the eighth F site, F is bonded to three Na and one Zr atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing FNa₃Zr tetrahedra. In the ninth F site, F is bonded to three Na and one Zr atom to form FNa₃Zr tetrahedra that share corners with ten FNa₂Zr₂ tetrahedra and edges with five FNa₃Zr tetrahedra. In the tenth F site, F is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two equivalent Zr atoms. In the eleventh F site, F is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three equivalent Zr atoms.
